highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 updates to Skia m156 while extending support for current .NET and Tizen toolchains.
highlights_body: This release refreshes the bundled renderer, aligns WebAssembly assets with .NET 11 previews, and restores system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 156 and includes the m155 core fork cleanup in the current release line.
Applications using the Linux NoDependencies packages can again discover fonts provided by the operating system.

bullets.lead: Current runtime and native platform assets aligned
bullets.detail: Aligns .NET 11 preview package support and WebAssembly native assets, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering with pixel scaling, and updates Tizen packaging for GCC 14.2.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored system-font discovery for Linux NoDependencies deployments
